_note: The factory's gauges. Every asset is built to these and checked against them. Change a number here, not in code.

conventions.axes: Blender Z-up, front faces -Y; exported GLB is Y-up, front faces +Z in Godot
conventions.origin: bottom centre: the object stands on z = 0
conventions.brands: fictional only; every supplied image is reviewed for real marks before building

building._why: Painted elevations come at 40-60 px/m; buildings are seen from the street, so the minimum is lower.

minimum_acceptable._note: Pass the gate, ship it. Do not polish past these: one automatic retry, then the order is flagged for a person.
minimum_acceptable._extreme_folds_note: Only automatically inferred solid surfaces: adjacent faces over 115 degrees after position welding. Review before relaxing; genuine sharp carvings can contribute.
minimum_acceptable._holes_note: see-through holes are only checked for solid production lines: chairs and tables have gaps by design

trim._calibration: Nov 8: correct pieces section IoU 0.955-0.994, wrong-profile pairings 0.44-0.64; colour: correct <= 0.112, walnut-vs-cream 0.284, mint-vs-cream 0.172, grey-vs-tan 0.074 (not separable by median colour).

mounting._note: How an object attaches decides the floor check. floor: must stand on z=0. wall/ceiling: origin is the mounting point. Set by tag or by name.

open_by_design._note: Objects with intended see-through gaps inside their outline (stands, frames, racks) even on solid lines.

screen_error_budget._note: How game studios size meshes: by how they look on screen, not one count per size class. A mesh may be simplified until its surface moves more than error_px pixels at the closest distance the player normally sees it from; curved and detailed parts keep triangles, flat ones lose them. The size class's tri_budget stays a hard ceiling. LODs: Godot 4 generates them on import, so one well-sized mesh is enough.
screen_error_budget.near_m_why: carried and read items are held at arm's length; fixtures (switches, wall phones) are used from standing close; furniture and appliances seen from across a room; cars from the street
